title: Gemini 3.2 Flash leaks in iOS app and AI Studio
summary: Gemini 3.2 Flash is reportedly being A/B tested through Antigravity, LM Arena, Google AI Studio and the Gemini iOS app. Pricing is reported at $0.25 per 1M input tokens and $2.00 per 1M output tokens, with a January 2026 knowledge cutoff.

research.notes: Confirmed as a real pre-I/O 2026 rollout. The host's video timestamps May 2026.

web_findings.title: Gemini 3.2 Flash: Google's Model Surfaces in iOS App and AI Studio Ahead of I/O 2026
web_findings.snippet: Gemini 3.2 Flash appeared inside the official iOS Gemini app and Google AI Studio on May 5, 2026.
